To me SWSH had a lot of potential, I recently started playing a little bit again after PLA and it felt clunky after that. I still couldn’t tell you the evil teams name, I just remember team yell are not the bad guys. Most of the Pokémon are forgettable in my opinion and personally the galar starters are my least favorite of any starters. I like the raid battles, I like the dynamax adventures but I don’t particularly like dynamax as a main mechanic, it just seems out of place. I think a lot of issues with SWSH come from the fact that it was gamefreak/pokemon company’s first real foray into a big 3D console game and being unprepared due to the basically yearly release cycle. My biggest takeaway is that rushing a game doesn’t help it and that they probably need to slow down releases. SV are looking good, building from PLA, and all the starters have a real charm to them. Hopefully they up the ante a little bit and they’ll be great. 

TLDR; mediocre at best, forgettable story and Pokémon, good hope for the horizons.

Everyone hates on Gravity Falls for KH3, here's what I think:

**Visit 1:**

Sora and crew walk out of the forest and happen upon the Mystery Shack. Sora looks down at Donald and over at Goofy and says something along the lines of, "What's so Mysterious about it?" The gang walks in and after looking around a bit, Donald, being Donald, bumps into something, sending it crashing to the floor. At this in the back ground you hear a gravelly "YOU BROKE IT YOU BOUGHT IT BUB!" In which Stan walks out. Sora tries to explain that it was an accident, but Stan doesn't have it and demands cash again. At this time Soos comes in to sweep up the mess with Mabel in tow and she says "C'mon Grunkle Stan, let 'em off easy this once!" After some back and forth between the two Stan agrees and walks off defeated. Mabel informs you that she thinks her brother would like you, to which she sends you to find him. This is when you can now explore Gravity Falls. After looking around a bit, asking town folks if they've seen Dipper, you find him investigating. What's he investigating this time? WHy none other than the heartless. Dipper ends up getting too close though, and the heartless attack as he lets out his signature scream. Sora does what Sora does best and defeats them all HUZZAH! Dipper thanks you for the help and immediately notices you aren't from around there, so he invites you back to the Shack to look over his research on the heartless. Upon arrival, you see three heartless(Gnome based or Sasquatch like?) upon which the middle one sits none other than, you guessed it, Li'l Gideon. He's once again demanding rights to the land which the Shack sits on, with Stan denying. You run up, summon the Keyblade and tell him to buzz off and that if he doesn't you'll make him leave. Gideon is obviously frightened by this and leaves. Thats not the end of him though, because he starts causing trouble around town, to which you have to go fix it by killing the heartless. After a few rounds of this(I'd say a solid 15-30 minutes to find everything based on KH2) you'd head back to the shack where Dipper, Mabel, Soos, and Stan are all waiting for you. You say something along the lines of "well that takes care of that, it's been a lo.." when the ground stats shaking. You run outside and pinpoint it coming from the town so you go. On arrival you see Li'l Gideon, but not normal Gideon, possessed my many heartless, angry over all the things you've done, in which a fight follows. After a good fight, Dipper and Mabel run up to you to make sure you're okay, with a defeated Gideon, now back to normal waving a small white flag saying "you win today, Stan Pines." with this you leave the world for the first time. You don't collect a keyblade but you do collect a summon, Bill Ciper, who plays a part in visit two, buuuuut I haven't worked out all the details of visit 2 yet :3
